## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Unit tests pass — Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes
- [ ] Format check passes
- [ ] tests/scripts/test-implementation-plan-step4-remediation.sh exists and is executable
- [ ] Fixture passes against updated SKILL.md — Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-implementation-plan-step4-remediation.sh
- [ ] SKILL.md Step 4 section contains Remediation Re-dispatch subsection
- [ ] Step 4 subsection triggers on plan-reviewer findings
- [ ] Step 4 subsection re-dispatches dso:task-decomposer
- [ ] Step 4 subsection contains model: "opus" literal
- [ ] Step 4 subsection contains remediation_context with reviewer_artifact_paths
- [ ] Step 4 subsection notes delta-mode / preserve-by-omission behavior
- [ ] Step 4 subsection ends with SC5 single-comment instruction
